pairs.registryProposal: A frame-stepped headless capture of a product's own render surface (record-clip.mjs) has the same mechanics as a driven demo capture. The golden path could say outright that capturing a system's content output (highlight clips) is out of scope, as opposed to capturing a demonstration of the system, so that seats do not misapply it.
